research_question: Do causal order-flow and top-of-book features predict 1-second future mid-price direction across successive closed UTC-hour blocks?

method.training_window: expanding history strictly before each test UTC hour
method.regularization_selection: chronological 80/20 split of prior history with a horizon-sized embargo
method.refit_after_selection: selected C is refit on all embargo-safe prior history
method.gap_handling: invalid rows and labels crossing gaps are excluded; disconnected valid segments may contribute independent rows but are never treated as adjacent
